title: Session
description: An authentication session, owned by IAM, with bounded lifetime. How strongly the session's principal authenticated is carried entirely by authentication_assurance (authentication-assurance.schema.json, ADR-0015 §180-181) -- see that schema's acr/amr for the OIDC-precise picture a step-up decision (AssuranceRequirement) needs. Session previously duplicated this with its own assurance_level/authentication_methods enums; those were removed as unconsumed (nothing in this repository or in baobab-cp/baobab-iam read them) rather than reconciled field-by-field against the vocabulary AuthenticationAssurance actually uses.
